summary: This is a clarification filing by SK Telecom regarding a media report. It states that a planned 2027 AI factory is not gigawatt-scale but will expand in phases. No special situation is involved; the filing is a routine foreign private issuer report correcting a rumor. There are no deal terms, recommendations, or structural mechanics typical of an M&A, activist, or restructuring event. The filing is simply a regulatory clarification under Form 6-K.
